newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce buys LucasVarity gearbox co.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce buys LucasVarity gearbox co.

text.p: Rolls-Royce Plc said on Tuesday it was buying a gearbox systems company, Geared Systems Inc, from automotive diesel engine and aerospace group LucasVarity Plc for an undisclosed amount.
Rolls-Royce said in a statement it was paying cash but that the deal would have a negligible impact on gearing and earnings for both companies.

Located in Utah, the U.S., Geared Systems Inc generates annual revenues of 25-30 million stg and will operate along with Allison Engine Company and other holdings as part of Rolls's North American operations.
"This strategic acquisition recognises the increasing importance of geared transmission systems within Rolls-Royce's broad aerospace product portfolio," the company said in a statement.
It represents less than two percent of Rolls-Royce's net asset value and less than three percent of LucasVarity's net asset value.
